angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 50,786,100 km at 2293.80 pc = 0.3 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, TW Nor: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 2293.8 +/- 205.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 2293.8 +/- 205.6 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.3175 +/- 0.0203 mas (same row, RUWE 0.89), 15.6 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 73 +/- 6.4 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, TW Nor: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 73 +/- 6.4 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 50,786,100 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5000 +/- 204 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 183, Name='TW Nor', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5000 +/- 204 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 183, Name='TW Nor', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5000 +/- 204 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
